# GSE competitor-intel processor for 10 assigned domains.
# Usage: python _run10.py domain1 [domain2 ...]
import json, os, re, sys, time, socket
from datetime import datetime, timezone

BASE = r'C:\Users\Garrett\.hermes\competitor-intel'
RAW = os.path.join(BASE, 'raw')
DOSS = os.path.join(BASE, 'dossiers')
os.makedirs(DOSS, exist_ok=True)
sys.path.insert(0, BASE)
import fetcher

BUDGET = 8
MARKERS = ['baseURL', 'apiRoot', 'axios', 'fetch(', 'isPremium', 'hasAccess',
           'subscription', 'numSims', 'monteCarlo', 'correlation', 'sportradar',
           'statsperform', 'opta', 'genius', 'the-odds-api', 'sportsdata.io',
           'nflverse', 'fantasydata', 'x-api-key', 'localStorage']
VENDORS = ['sportradar', 'statsperform', 'opta', 'genius', 'the-odds-api',
           'sportsdata.io', 'nflverse', 'fantasydata']
NC = 'NOT CONFIRMED'

def now():
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()

def prefix_for(domain):
    return domain.replace('/', '_')

def dns_ok(host):
    try:
        socket.getaddrinfo(host, 443)
        return True, None
    except Exception as e:
        return False, f'{type(e).__name__}: {e}'

def save_raw(name, url, status, body):
    p = os.path.join(RAW, name)
    with open(p, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        f.write(f'URL: {url}\nSTATUS: {status}\n\n{body[:1_500_000]}')
    return p

class Runner:
    def __init__(self, domain):
        self.domain = domain
        self.pfx = prefix_for(domain)
        self.used = 0
        self.requests = []
        self.raw_files = []
        self.notes = []
        self.hdrs = {}

    def get(self, url, save_name=None, max_bytes=3_000_000, count=True):
        if count and self.used >= BUDGET:
            self.requests.append({'url': url, 'status': 'SKIPPED_BUDGET'})
            return {'status': 'SKIPPED', 'error': 'budget exhausted', 'body': '', 'headers': {}}
        if count:
            self.used += 1
        r = fetcher.fetch(url, save_name=save_name, max_bytes=max_bytes)
        if r.get('status') == 200 and save_name:
            self.raw_files.append(save_name)
        self.requests.append({'url': url, 'status': r.get('status'), 'error': r.get('error'), 'ms': r.get('ms')})
        for k in ('server', 'x-powered-by', 'cf-ray', 'x-vercel-id', 'via'):
            if r.get('headers', {}).get(k):
                self.hdrs[k] = r['headers'][k]
        time.sleep(1)
        return r

    def note(self, msg):
        self.notes.append(msg)
        print('  [note]', str(msg)[:180])

    # ---------- phase 1 ----------
    def phase1(self):
        url = f'https://{self.domain}/'
        h = self.get(url, save_name=f'{self.pfx}_home.html')
        if h.get('status') != 200:
            self.note(f'GET https://{self.domain}/ failed status={h.get("status")} err={h.get("error")}')
            # DNS diagnosis (no HTTP cost)
            host = self.domain.split('/')[0]
            ok, err = dns_ok(host)
            self.dns = {'host': host, 'resolves': ok, 'error': err}
            if not ok:
                errtext = f'DNS failure for {host}: {err}'
                p = save_raw(f'{self.pfx}_DNS_FAILURE.txt', f'https://{host}/', 'DNS_FAIL', errtext)
                self.raw_files.append(os.path.basename(p))
                self.note('domain does not resolve -> dead')
                return False
        else:
            self.dns = {'host': self.domain, 'resolves': True, 'error': None}
        self.home = h
        return h.get('status') == 200

    # ---------- phase 2: robots + sitemap ----------
    def phase2(self):
        self.robots = self.get(f'https://{self.domain}/robots.txt', save_name=f'{self.pfx}_robots.txt')
        sm = self.get(f'https://{self.domain}/sitemap.xml', save_name=f'{self.pfx}_sitemap.xml')
        if sm.get('status') != 200:
            sm = self.get(f'https://{self.domain}/sitemaps.xml', save_name=f'{self.pfx}_sitemaps.xml')
        self.sitemap = sm
        return sm.get('status') == 200

    # ---------- phase 3: JS bundles ----------
    def collect_js_urls(self):
        body = self.home.get('body', '') if self.home else ''
        urls = re.findall(r'<script[^>]+src=["\']([^"\']+)["\']', body, re.I)
        out = []
        for u in urls:
            if u.startswith('//'):
                u = 'https:' + u
            elif u.startswith('/'):
                u = f'https://{self.domain}{u}'
            elif not u.startswith('http'):
                u = f'https://{self.domain}/{u}'
            skip = ('googletag', 'gtag', 'analytics', 'hotjar', 'clarity', 'facebook',
                    'googlesyndication', 'doubleclick', 'adsbygoogle', 'adservice')
            if not any(x in u for x in skip):
                out.append(u)
        seen, uniq = set(), []
        for u in out:
            if u not in seen:
                seen.add(u)
                uniq.append(u)
        return uniq

    def phase3(self):
        self.js_urls = self.collect_js_urls()
        self.js_results = []
        for u in self.js_urls[:3]:
            fname = re.sub(r'[^A-Za-z0-9._-]', '_', u.split('/')[-1].split('?')[0])[:60] or 'bundle'
            r = self.get(u, save_name=f'{self.pfx}_js_{fname}.js')
            if r.get('status') == 200:
                low = r['body'].lower()
                markers = {m: low.count(m.lower()) for m in MARKERS if m.lower() in low}
                api_eps = sorted(set(re.findall(r'["\'](/api/[A-Za-z0-9._/\-{}$]+)["\']', r['body'])))[:25]
                vend = sorted(set(v for v in VENDORS if v in low))
                self.js_results.append({'url': u, 'bytes': len(r['body']), 'markers': markers,
                                        'api_endpoints': api_eps, 'vendors': vend,
                                        'file': f'{self.pfx}_js_{fname}.js'})
            else:
                self.js_results.append({'url': u, 'status': r.get('status'), 'error': r.get('error')})
        return self.js_results

    # ---------- phase 4: api/docs probes (keeps 1 req spare for pricing) ----------
    def phase4(self):
        self.api_probes = []
        for p in ('/openapi.json', '/swagger.json', '/api', '/api/v1', '/docs', '/pricing'):
            if self.used >= BUDGET:
                self.note('budget exhausted; stopping probes')
                break
            r = self.get(f'https://{self.domain}{p}')
            self.api_probes.append({'path': p, 'status': r.get('status'), 'err': r.get('error'),
                                    'ct': r.get('headers', {}).get('content-type')})
            if p == '/pricing' and r.get('status') == 200:
                self.pricing_html = r['body']
        return self.api_probes

    # ---------- dossier ----------
    def write(self, disposition, status, key_findings, extra=None):
        d = {
            'domain': self.domain,
            'tech_stack': {'frontend': NC, 'backend': NC, 'database': NC, 'cloud': NC, 'cdn': NC, 'citations': []},
            'api_architecture': {'rest_endpoints': [], 'graphql_schema': NC, 'websocket_endpoints': NC,
                                 'rate_limits': NC, 'citations': []},
            'extracted_formulas': [],
            'ml_model_infrastructure': {'model_types': NC, 'training_data': NC, 'update_frequency': NC, 'citation': NC},
            'simulation_engine': {'num_simulations': NC, 'correlation_method': NC, 'citation': NC},
            'data_supply_chain': {'vendors': [], 'citations': []},
            'product_limits': {'limits': NC, 'upgrade_triggers': NC, 'citation': NC},
            'pricing': {'web': NC, 'ios': NC, 'android': NC, 'citations': []},
            'customer_pain': [],
            'discovered_paths': [],
            'discovered_targets': [],
            'discovery_metadata': {'method': 'urllib GET via fetcher.py pattern; 8-HTTP-req budget',
                                   'timestamp': now()},
            'disposition': disposition,
            'status': status,
            'key_findings': key_findings,
            'requests_log': self.requests,
            'raw_files': self.raw_files,
            'notes': self.notes,
            'infra_headers': self.hdrs,
        }
        if extra:
            for k, v in extra.items():
                d[k] = v
        p = os.path.join(DOSS, f'{self.pfx}.json')
        with open(p, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
            json.dump(d, f, indent=2)
        print(f'  [dossier] {p} disposition={disposition}')
        return p

Purposes & Features

Purposes (11)

Store and/or access information on a device

Consent

Cookies, device or similar online identifiers (e.g. login-based identifiers, randomly assigned identifiers, network based identifiers) together with other information (e.g. browser type and information, language, screen size, supported technologies etc.) can be stored or read on your device to recognise it each time it connects to an app or to a website, for one or several of the purposes presented here.

Illustrations

- Most purposes explained in this notice rely on the storage or accessing of information from your device when you use an app or visit a website. For example, a vendor or publisher might need to store a cookie on your device during your first visit on a website, to be able to recognise your device during your next visits (by accessing this cookie each time).

Number of Vendors seeking consent: 837

Use limited data to select advertising

Legitimate Interest

Consent

Advertising presented to you on this service can be based on limited data, such as the website or app you are using, your non-precise location, your device type or which content you are (or have been) interacting with (for example, to limit the number of times an ad is presented to you).

Illustrations

- A car manufacturer wants to promote its electric vehicles to environmentally conscious users living in the city after office hours. The advertising is presented on a page with related content (such as an article on climate change actions) after 6:30 p.m. to users whose non-precise location suggests that they are in an urban zone.
- A large producer of watercolour paints wants to carry out an online advertising campaign for its latest watercolour range, diversifying its audience to reach as many amateur and professional artists as possible and avoiding showing the ad next to mismatched content (for instance, articles about how to paint your house). The number of times that the ad has been presented to you is detected and limited, to avoid presenting it too often.

Number of Vendors seeking consent or relying on legitimate interest: 781

Create profiles for personalised advertising

Consent

Information about your activity on this service (such as forms you submit, content you look at) can be stored and combined with other information about you (for example, information from your previous activity on this service and other websites or apps) or similar users. This is then used to build or improve a profile about you (that might include possible interests and personal aspects). Your profile can be used (also later) to present advertising that appears more relevant based on your possible interests by this and other entities.

Illustrations

- If you read several articles about the best bike accessories to buy, this information could be used to create a profile about your interest in bike accessories. Such a profile may be used or improved later on, on the same or a different website or app to present you with advertising for a particular bike accessory brand. If you also look at a configurator for a vehicle on a luxury car manufacturer website, this information could be combined with your interest in bikes to refine your profile and make an assumption that you are interested in luxury cycling gear.
- An apparel company wishes to promote its new line of high-end baby clothes. It gets in touch with an agency that has a network of clients with high income customers (such as high-end supermarkets) and asks the agency to create profiles of young parents or couples who can be assumed to be wealthy and to have a new child, so that these can later be used to present advertising within partner apps based on those profiles.

Number of Vendors seeking consent: 624

Use profiles to select personalised advertising

Consent

Advertising presented to you on this service can be based on your advertising profiles, which can reflect your activity on this service or other websites or apps (like the forms you submit, content you look at), possible interests and personal aspects.

Illustrations

- An online retailer wants to advertise a limited sale on running shoes. It wants to target advertising to users who previously looked at running shoes on its mobile app. Tracking technologies might be used to recognise that you have previously used the mobile app to consult running shoes, in order to present you with the corresponding advertisement on the app.
- A profile created for personalised advertising in relation to a person having searched for bike accessories on a website can be used to present the relevant advertisement for bike accessories on a mobile app of another organisation.

Number of Vendors seeking consent: 628

Create profiles to personalise content

Consent

Information about your activity on this service (for instance, forms you submit, non-advertising content you look at) can be stored and combined with other information about you (such as your previous activity on this service or other websites or apps) or similar users. This is then used to build or improve a profile about you (which might for example include possible interests and personal aspects). Your profile can be used (also later) to present content that appears more relevant based on your possible interests, such as by adapting the order in which content is shown to you, so that it is even easier for you to find content that matches your interests.

Illustrations

- You read several articles on how to build a treehouse on a social media platform. This information might be added to a profile to mark your interest in content related to outdoors as well as do-it-yourself guides (with the objective of allowing the personalisation of content, so that for example you are presented with more blog posts and articles on treehouses and wood cabins in the future).
- You have viewed three videos on space exploration across different TV apps. An unrelated news platform with which you have had no contact builds a profile based on that viewing behaviour, marking space exploration as a topic of possible interest for other videos.

Number of Vendors seeking consent: 258

Use profiles to select personalised content

Consent

title: _rw-about.md — part 6/9
body:
Content presented to you on this service can be based on your content personalisation profiles, which can reflect your activity on this or other services (for instance, the forms you submit, content you look at), possible interests and personal aspects. This can for example be used to adapt the order in which content is shown to you, so that it is even easier for you to find (non-advertising) content that matches your interests.

Illustrations

- You read articles on vegetarian food on a social media platform and then use the cooking app of an unrelated company. The profile built about you on the social media platform will be used to present you vegetarian recipes on the welcome screen of the cooking app.
- You have viewed three videos about rowing across different websites. An unrelated video sharing platform will recommend five other videos on rowing that may be of interest to you when you use your TV app, based on a profile built about you when you visited those different websites to watch online videos.

Number of Vendors seeking consent: 230

Measure advertising performance

Legitimate Interest

Consent

Information regarding which advertising is presented to you and how you interact with it can be used to determine how well an advert has worked for you or other users and whether the goals of the advertising were reached. For instance, whether you saw an ad, whether you clicked on it, whether it led you to buy a product or visit a website, etc. This is very helpful to understand the relevance of advertising campaigns.

Illustrations

- You have clicked on an advertisement about a “black Friday” discount by an online shop on the website of a publisher and purchased a product. Your click will be linked to this purchase. Your interaction and that of other users will be measured to know how many clicks on the ad led to a purchase.
- You are one of very few to have clicked on an advertisement about an “international appreciation day” discount by an online gift shop within the app of a publisher. The publisher wants to have reports to understand how often a specific ad placement within the app, and notably the “international appreciation day” ad, has been viewed or clicked by you and other users, in order to help the publisher and its partners (such as agencies) optimise ad placements.

Number of Vendors seeking consent or relying on legitimate interest: 898

Measure content performance

Legitimate Interest

Consent

Information regarding which content is presented to you and how you interact with it can be used to determine whether the (non-advertising) content e.g. reached its intended audience and matched your interests. For instance, whether you read an article, watch a video, listen to a podcast or look at a product description, how long you spent on this service and the web pages you visit etc. This is very helpful to understand the relevance of (non-advertising) content that is shown to you.

Illustrations

- You have read a blog post about hiking on a mobile app of a publisher and followed a link to a recommended and related post. Your interactions will be recorded as showing that the initial hiking post was useful to you and that it was successful in interesting you in the related post. This will be measured to know whether to produce more posts on hiking in the future and where to place them on the home screen of the mobile app.
- You were presented a video on fashion trends, but you and several other users stopped watching after 30 seconds. This information is then used to evaluate the right length of future videos on fashion trends.

Number of Vendors seeking consent or relying on legitimate interest: 405

Understand audiences through statistics or combinations of data from different sources

Legitimate Interest

Consent

Reports can be generated based on the combination of data sets (like user profiles, statistics, market research, analytics data) regarding your interactions and those of other users with advertising or (non-advertising) content to identify common characteristics (for instance, to determine which target audiences are more receptive to an ad campaign or to certain contents).

Illustrations

- The owner of an online bookstore wants commercial reporting showing the proportion of visitors who consulted and left its site without buying, or consulted and bought the last celebrity autobiography of the month, as well as the average age and the male/female distribution of each category. Data relating to your navigation on its site and to your personal characteristics is then used and combined with other such data to produce these statistics.
- An advertiser wants to better understand the type of audience interacting with its adverts. It calls upon a research institute to compare the characteristics of users who interacted with the ad with typical attributes of users of similar platforms, across different devices. This comparison reveals to the advertiser that its ad audience is mainly accessing the adverts through mobile devices and is likely in the 45-60 age range.

Number of Vendors seeking consent or relying on legitimate interest: 569

Develop and improve services

Legitimate Interest

Consent

Information about your activity on this service, such as your interaction with ads or content, can be very helpful to improve products and services and to build new products and services based on user interactions, the type of audience, etc. This specific purpose does not include the development or improvement of user profiles and identifiers.

Illustrations

- A technology platform working with a social media provider notices a growth in mobile app users, and sees based on their profiles that many of them are connecting through mobile connections. It uses a new technology to deliver ads that are formatted for mobile devices and that are low-bandwidth, to improve their performance.
- An advertiser is looking for a way to display ads on a new type of consumer device. It collects information regarding the way users interact with this new kind of device to determine whether it can build a new mechanism for displaying advertising on this type of device.

Number of Vendors seeking consent or relying on legitimate interest: 674

Use limited data to select content

Legitimate Interest

Consent

Content presented to you on this service can be based on limited data, such as the website or app you are using, your non-precise location, your device type, or which content you are (or have been) interacting with (for example, to limit the number of times a video or an article is presented to you).

Illustrations

- A travel magazine has published an article on its website about the new online courses proposed by a language school, to improve travelling experiences abroad. The school’s blog posts are inserted directly at the bottom of the page, and selected on the basis of your non-precise location (for instance, blog posts explaining the course curriculum for different languages than the language of the country you are situated in).
- A sports news mobile app has started a new section of articles covering the most recent football games. Each article includes videos hosted by a separate streaming platform showcasing the highlights of each match. If you fast-forward a video, this information may be used to select a shorter video to play next.

Number of Vendors seeking consent or relying on legitimate interest: 175

Special Purposes (3)

Ensure security, prevent and detect fraud, and fix errors

Your data can be used to monitor for and prevent unusual and possibly fraudulent activity (for example, regarding advertising, ad clicks by bots), and ensure systems and processes work properly and securely. It can also be used to correct any problems you, the publisher or the advertiser may encounter in the delivery of content and ads and in your interaction with them.

Illustrations

- An advertising intermediary delivers ads from various advertisers to its network of partnering websites. It notices a large increase in clicks on ads relating to one advertiser, and uses data regarding the source of the clicks to determine that 80% of the clicks come from bots rather than humans.

Number of Vendors seeking consent: 640

Deliver and present advertising and content

Certain information (like an IP address or device capabilities) is used to ensure the technical compatibility of the content or advertising, and to facilitate the transmission of the content or ad to your device.

Illustrations

- Clicking on a link in an article might normally send you to another page or part of the article. To achieve this, 1°) your browser sends a request to a server linked to the website, 2°) the server answers back (“here is the article you asked for”), using technical information automatically included in the request sent by your device, to properly display the information / images that are part of the article you asked for. Technically, such exchange of information is necessary to deliver the content that appears on your screen.

Number of Vendors seeking consent: 627

Save and communicate privacy choices

The choices you make regarding the purposes and entities listed in this notice are saved and made available to those entities in the form of digital signals (such as a string of characters). This is necessary in order to enable both this service and those entities to respect such choices.

Illustrations

- When you visit a website and are offered a choice between consenting to the use of profiles for personalised advertising or not consenting, the choice you make is saved and made available to advertising providers, so that advertising presented to you respects that choice.

Number of Vendors seeking consent: 500

Features (3)

Match and combine data from other data sources

Information about your activity on this service may be matched and combined with other information relating to you and originating from various sources (for instance your activity on a separate online service, your use of a loyalty card in-store, or your answers to a survey), in support of the purposes explained in this notice.

Number of Vendors seeking consent: 448

Link different devices

In support of the purposes explained in this notice, your device might be considered as likely linked to other devices that belong to you or your household (for instance because you are logged in to the same service on both your phone and your computer, or because you may use the same Internet connection on both devices).

Number of Vendors seeking consent: 371

Identify devices based on information transmitted automatically

Your device might be distinguished from other devices based on information it automatically sends when accessing the Internet (for instance, the IP address of your Internet connection or the type of browser you are using) in support of the purposes exposed in this notice.

Number of Vendors seeking consent: 587

Special Features (2)

Use precise geolocation data

Consent

With your acceptance, your precise location (within a radius of less than 500 metres) may be used in support of the purposes explained in this notice.

Number of Vendors seeking consent: 284

Actively scan device characteristics for identification

Consent

With your acceptance, certain characteristics specific to your device might be requested and used to distinguish it from other devices (such as the installed fonts or plugins, the resolution of your screen) in support of the purposes explained in this notice.

# About RotoWire

Your premium source for fantasy sports.

RotoWire is your premium fantasy sports resource. We pioneered real-time fantasy sports news and Player Notes back in 1997 when the Internet was just taking flight.

We've stayed ahead of imitators with the most in-depth analysis, the fastest real-time news and the largest scope of coverage of any fantasy sports site or app.

![RotoWire.com](https://content.rotowire.com/images/rotowire-site-logo-blue.svg)

Our quality has won us many industry awards – it's why we have high-profile partners such as ESPN, Yahoo! Sports, Fox Sports, CBS Sports, DraftKings and NBA.com.

We're Board and Hall Of Fame members of the [Fantasy Sports & Gaming Association](https://thefsga.org/) and [Fantasy Sports Writers Association](https://www.fswa.org/). We're regularly invited to the top fantasy expert leagues, such as the USA Today Sports Weekly Baseball LABR league, Tout Wars, Yahoo! Sports experts leagues and more.

Our Innovations

- The Fantasy Industry's first real-time player news in 1997. (You'll notice all our competitors copied our format that uses a "news" and "analysis" for each player note. We invented that in 1997).
- The Fantasy Industry's first real-time customized cheat sheet in 1998.
- The Fantasy Industry's first free online commissioner service in 1998 (we learned our lesson and later went pay).
- The first online site to offer a fantasy sports magazine in print in 2000.
- The first web site to offer wireless player updates in 2004.
- Pioneered the DFS lineup optimizer in 2012.

Company History

In 1997, three Northwestern graduates, Peter Schoenke, Jeff Erickson and Herb Ilk, came up with an idea that changed the fantasy sports market forever: to provide real-time news and analysis for fantasy sports junkies like themselves. RotoNews.com was born and revolutionized the industry.

Not long after they launched the site, the founders realized that the demand for real-time information was beyond even their wildest expectations. Suddenly, RotoNews was consistently ranked among the 10 largest sports sites in surveys by both Media Metrix and PC Data, topping such sites as FoxSports.com. RotoNews became so big that the owners decided to chase the same dot-com bubble as everyone else and sold the company to a West Coast corporation in 1999. In 2001 that company's management (which the RotoNews founders were not part of), misjudged the "new economy" and went bankrupt. RotoNews.com was stuck in bankruptcy limbo.

![](https://content.rotowire.com/images/logo_rotonews.gif)

The RotoNews team decided to march on and continue to provide the fantasy news, information and commissioner services that served the industry so well, but as a new business: RotoWire.com. The tremendous changes in the Internet advertising market also caused the business model of the new web site to change and our content went from free to a pay model.

The same editors, writers, and programmers that made RotoNews created RotoWire. During the 2000s and 2010s, our core group remained the same: Peter Schoenke, Jeff Erickson, Chris Liss, Herb Ilk, Jason Thornbury, Mike Doria, Tim Schuler, Tim McCague, and Shannon McKeown. That team, along with a large network of writers, kept our fantasy sports coverage the best on the web.

In 2003, RotoWire signed an agreement with our first syndication partner: ESPN. RotoWire now syndicates content to 80+ partners, including 15 professional sports teams.

In January of 2022, RotoWire was acquired by the Gambling.com Group (NASDAQ: GAMB). The acquisition provided RotoWire with more resources, allowing us to deliver an even better product. It also spurred us to expand our coverage "to capitalize on the new era of American sports – the betting and gaming era," per Charles Gillespie, CEO of Gambling.com. The core RotoWire team, excited by the partnership with Gambling.com, continues to be led by Peter Schoenke, Jeff Erickson, Tim Schuler, Jason Thornbury, Mike Doria, and Shannon McKeown, as well as Nick Whalen, Ken Crites, Kevin O'Brien, and many others.

Our goal is the same from back when we started: to be the best resource of real-time information and draft preparation for fantasy players anywhere. The business model may have changed, and competitors and knock-off copycats of our original concept may have emerged, but few will deny we still produce the most timely and thorough information on the web.

We're constantly trying to improve upon our original concept, so please give us your feedback. What can we do better? [Please let us know.](https://www.rotowire.com/contact.php)

## Viborg Team Overview

The visitors last took to the pitch on in a Club Friendly, facing Viborg away from home. Viborg came out on top with a 2-0 victory over Notts County.

Here’s how the stats broke down (Viborg vs Notts County):

- Possession: 52% vs 48%;
- Corners: 4 vs 4;
- Yellow cards: 2 vs 3;
- Shots on target: 3 vs 2.

Viborg are approaching this preseason in a completely different manner. With no European commitments, the coaching staff has the luxury of taking their time with preparations and experimenting extensively with the lineup. In almost every friendly, they field two separate elevens, one for the first half, and a fresh set after the break. This kind of rotation gives the staff a chance to assess a broad range of players, though it does come at the expense of team cohesion.

Their preseason results have been mixed so far. The clash against Aalborg ended in a 1-3 defeat, exposing vulnerabilities in midfield following Sønnergaard’s injury. On the other hand, Viborg cruised to a convincing 2-0 win over Notts County, with Dorian Junior bagging a brace by exploiting gaps in the opposition’s defense. At this stage, fast counter-attacks remain Viborg’s main weapon as they gear up for the new campaign.

import os
import json
import requests
from InquirerPy import inquirer


json_dir = os.path.join("Prediction dir", "raw files")
os.makedirs(json_dir, exist_ok=True)

predictions_endpoint = "https://scores24.live/graphql"

cookies = {
    'testValue': '1',
    'bannerValue': '1',
    'userOddFormat': 'EU',
    'machineTimezone': 'GMT+5:30',
    'cookiesAccepted': '1',
    '_ym_uid': '1766933521295718120',
    '_ym_d': '1767272335',
    '_ga': 'GA1.1.1417545567.1767272355',
    '_ym_uid': '1766933521295718120',
    '_ga_ZPJ1YWQ2Z0': 'GS2.1.s1767272355$o1$g0$t1767272359$j56$l0$h0',
    '_ga_L002PTBYML': 'GS2.1.s1767272355$o1$g0$t1767272359$j56$l0$h0',
    '_subid': '1q2aj1titp74p',
    '_token': 'uuid_1q2aj1titp74p_1q2aj1titp74p6962ff732c39b5.82628598',
    's24-session': 'i4pZhwDbN8xBaukDFOu8XaIJdWJ0WD2w1pdAVgO7',
    'clever-counter-86866': '0-1',
    'adScriptNew': '4',
    'latestWidth': '1707',
}

headers = {
    'x-api-token': 'ufnoof',
    'sec-ch-ua-platform': '"Windows"',
    'Referer': 'https://scores24.live/en/predictions',
    'x-api-timestamp': '1768627106',
    'sec-ch-ua': '"Not)A;Brand";v="8", "Chromium";v="138", "Google Chrome";v="138"',
    'sec-ch-ua-mobile': '?0',
    'x-user-ip': '112.110.54.156',
    'x-user-cache': 'W2ZO6w9f6OdiBrEL9DMG',
    'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/138.0.0.0 Safari/537.36',
    'accept': 'application/graphql-response+json, application/graphql+json, application/json, text/event-stream, multipart/mixed',
    'accept-language': 'en-US,en;q=0.9',
    'x-country': 'in',
    'content-type': 'application/json',
    'x-bot-identifier': 'client',
    'x-ssr-ip': '112.110.54.156',
}

# Default/Best params
json_data = {
    'operationName': 'PredictionsSports',
    'query': 'query PredictionsSports($sportSlugs: [String!], $langSlug: String!, $orderBy: String, $orderType: String, $leagueSlugs: [String], $timezoneOffset: Int, $day: DayEnum, $votesType: PredictionVotesTypeEnum, $first: Int!, $after: String, $topMatches: Boolean, $marketSlugs: [String]) {\n  SportPrediction(\n    sport_slug: $sportSlugs\n    lang: $langSlug\n    day: $day\n    timezone_offset: $timezoneOffset\n    league_slugs: $leagueSlugs\n    votes_type: $votesType\n    order_type: $orderType\n    order_by: $orderBy\n    first: $first\n    after: $after\n    top_matches: $topMatches\n    market_slugs: $marketSlugs\n  ) {\n    sportKey: sport_key\n    slug\n    name\n    count\n    items {\n      edges {\n        cursor\n        node {\n          ...PredictionsCardFragment\n          __typename\n        }\n        __typename\n      }\n      pageInfo {\n        endCursor\n        hasNextPage\n        __typename\n      }\n      __typename\n    }\n    __typename\n  }\n}\nfragment PredictionsCardFragment on CachedPrediction {\n  prediction\n  predictionValue: prediction_value\n  allVotesCount: all_votes_count\n  agreedVotesPercent: agreed_votes_percent\n  match {\n    ...MatchCacheFragment\n    uniqueTournament: unique_tournament {\n      ...LeagueCacheFragment\n      name\n      __typename\n    }\n    country {\n      ...CountryFragment\n      __typename\n    }\n    teams {\n      ...TeamCacheFragment\n      name\n      logo\n      __typename\n    }\n    __typename\n  }\n  __typename\n}\nfragment MatchCacheFragment on Match {\n  slug\n  matchDate: match_date\n  langSlug: lang_slug\n  __typename\n}\nfragment LeagueCacheFragment on League {\n  slug\n  langSlug: lang_slug\n  sportSlug: sport_slug\n  __typename\n}\nfragment CountryFragment on Country {\n  name\n  slug\n  iso\n  __typename\n}\nfragment TeamCacheFragment on Team {\n  slug\n  langSlug: lang_slug\n  name\n  temporarilyQualified: temporarily_qualified\n  __typename\n}',
    'variables': {
        'first': 6,
        'langSlug': 'en',
        'sportSlugs': [
            'soccer', 
            'ice-hockey', 
            'basketball', 
            'tennis', 
            'futsal', 
            'mma', 
            'snooker', 
            'baseball', 
            'american-football', 
            'csgo', 
            'volleyball', 
            'rugby', 
            'handball', 
            'boxing',
            ],
        'timezoneOffset': 330,
    },
}

# All options
mode_options = ["Best", "Custom"]
time_options = ["all", "today", "tomorrow"]
sport_options = ["all", 'soccer', 'ice-hockey', 'basketball', 'tennis', 'futsal', 'mma', 'snooker', 'baseball', 'american-football', 'csgo', 'volleyball', 'rugby', 'handball', 'boxing',]


def main():
    print("\nUse arrow keys to select options ⬇️ ⬆️\n")

    selected_mode = inquirer.select(message="Select prediction mode: ", choices=mode_options, max_height=len(mode_options)).execute()

    if selected_mode == "Custom":
        selected_time = inquirer.select(message="Select predictions time: ", choices=time_options, max_height=len(time_options)).execute()
        selected_sport = inquirer.select(message="Select sports", choices=sport_options, max_height=len(sport_options)).execute()

        if selected_time != "all":
            json_data["variables"]["day"] = selected_time
        
        if selected_sport != "all":
            json_data["variables"]["sportSlugs"] = [selected_sport,]

        print(f"""
Here's what you choose:
  Mode: {selected_mode}
  Time: {selected_time}
  Sports: {selected_sport}
""")
        
        print("Generating custom predictions...")
        
    if selected_mode == "Best":
        print("Generating best predictions...")

    response = requests.post(url=predictions_endpoint, cookies=cookies, headers=headers, json=json_data)

    if response.status_code == 200:
        file_path = os.path.join(json_dir, "test_1.json")

        with open (file_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(response.json(), f, indent=4, ensure_ascii=False)

        print("Success! File saved as test-1.json")
        print("Check if there's a 'test-1.json' file appears in the scraper folder")
    else:
        print("Request failed! Status code:", response.status_code)

    input("\nPress Enter to exit...")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

You can also break things down based on strength of starters/bench, view your best and worst picks by round and see the draft board in its entirety.

title: _verify-freshness-live.md — part 2/5
body:
Get the most thorough cross-section of fantasy football projections right here! We offer a consensus of projections provided from multiple sources – and if you’re more interested in a player’s potential range of outcomes, we offer that, as well. Included here is a “ [Projected Leaders](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/projections/leaders.php)” section where you can see where the projection systems rank players in a variety of categories.

[![](https://cdn.fantasypros.com/wp-content/uploads/Screen-Shot-2020-07-09-at-2.28.31-PM-560x326.png)](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/projections/leaders.php)

**[Fantasy Strength of Schedule](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/strength-of-schedule.php)** Which fantasy players have the easiest or most difficult fantasy schedules for the coming season? We have the answers in our team-by-team Strength of Schedule tool, which displays the relative ease or difficulty of each NFL team’s matchups for the season. SOS is based on each opponent’s fantasy points allowed to a position, adjusted for strength of schedule. Favorable matchups receive better matchup star ratings. You can learn more about the methodology [here](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl-matchup-ratings/).

**[Fantasy Depth Charts](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/depth-charts.php)** You need to know each teams’ pecking order come draft day – so let us help you with our easy-to-follow Depth Charts tool, which is updated frequently – and includes each player’s overall Expert Consensus Rankings, so you know which backups are worth watching the most as you get into the latter stages of your fantasy draft.

**[Value-Based Drafting Tool](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/rankings/vbd.php)** Not down with VBD? Well, you should be! We offer a detailed look at each player’s standing using value-based drafting (VBD), a strategy that assigns a value to every player by comparing that player’s fantasy points to the fantasy points of a baseline player at the same position. A high VBD means a player offers strong incremental value at his position and is therefore valuable overall in fantasy. Check out our [Value-Based Drafting Guide](https://www.fantasypros.com/2017/06/what-is-value-based-drafting/) for more VBD insight.

**[Fantasy Matchup Calendar](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/matchups/qb.php)** Get a handle on just what kind of schedule your fantasy players have on the horizon with out Fantasy Matchup Calendar, which assigns each player a grade out of five stars based on the difficulty of their upcoming games. Ratings are based on a combination of opponents’ points against (adjusted for SOS) and the player’s overall skill level.

[QB](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/matchups/qb.php) \| [RB](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/matchups/rb.php) \| [WR](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/matchups/wr.php) \| [TE](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/matchups/te.php) \| [K](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/matchups/k.php) \| [DST](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/matchups/dst.php)

[![](https://cdn.fantasypros.com/wp-content/uploads/Screen-Shot-2020-06-25-at-9.29.27-AM-560x530.png)](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/matchups/qb.php)

[**Running Back Handcuffs**](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/running-back-handcuffs.php)

Whether you believe in securing your elite running back’s handcuff or you’re looking to poach someone else’s, we have the perfect tool for you. Not only do we provide the most valuable handcuffs to own from a fantasy football standpoint (with adjustable scoring format and league size), we also include their current Expert Consensus Ranking – along with where they’re presently being drafted, so you know exactly how early you’ll have to commit to one if you want him.

We track Expert Accuracy across both draft and in-season player rankings, while branching off by position so you’ll know which experts have excelled most at rating quarterbacks, running backs, wide receivers or tight ends. [Season-to-Date](http://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/accuracy/ "Year-to-Date") \| [Weekly](http://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/accuracy/weekly.php "Weekly") \| [Draft](http://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/accuracy/draft.php "Draft")

**[Dissenting Opinions](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/rankings/compare-experts.php)** What does our Dissenting Opinions tool provide? Imagine pitting two of your favorite fantasy football experts against one another in a fight to the death. Now, remove the “fight to the death” part (we’re not savages, after all.) And there you have it! You can compare any of our contributors to the Expert Consensus Ranking against another expert, or against the main ECR list, and see how their rankings compare; you can also limit the results to gaps of between two and 30 spots in the rankings, so you can see where the experts differ most.

**[Expert Directory](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/rankings/)** It’s the ideal spot for all of your FantasyPros expert needs! In addition to offering easy access to our updated Expert Consensus Rankings (highlighted by the top five across the three main scoring setups and available for either draft or in-season rankings), we also include a list of the top 100 experts that have submitted rankings! We also list when those rankings were updated, and offer direct links to the experts’ rankings and how they compare to ECR, ADP and other individual experts. Bookmark this page right now!

openapi: 3.1.1
info:
  title: FantasyPros Public API
  description: >-
    This is the free limited public API. To request an API key, go to
    https://secure.fantasypros.com/api-keys/request/ and apply. The base url for
    this API is: https://api.fantasypros.com/public/v2/json
  contact:
    name: FantasyPros
    url: https://www.fantasypros.com
    email: api@fantasypros.com
  version: '2.0'
  termsOfService: https://api.fantasypros.com/public/v2/terms-of-use
  x-logo:
    url: >-
      https://images.fantasypros.com/images/branding/fantasypros-fullcolor-light-bg.svg
    altText: FantasyPros logo
servers:
  - url: https://api.fantasypros.com/public/v2/json
    description: test
tags:
  - name: Players
    description: >-
      Player rosters, metadata, and head-to-head comparisons across all
      supported sports.
  - name: News & Injuries
    description: Breaking player news, impact analysis, and current injury statuses.
  - name: Rankings
    description: >-
      Expert rankings, consensus rankings, and expert profiles by position and
      scoring format.
  - name: Projections
    description: Projected statistics for NFL, MLB, and NBA players.
  - name: Scoring & Lineups
    description: >-
      NFL fantasy points scored by players and confirmed or projected MLB
      batting orders.
paths:
  /{sport}/players:
    get:
      summary: Players
      tags:
        - Players
      x-codeSamples:
        - lang: cURL
          label: cURL
          source: >
            curl
            "https://api.fantasypros.com/public/v2/json/nfl/players?ecr=included&show=pos_rank"
            -H "x-api-key: YOUR_API_KEY"
        - lang: JavaScript
          label: JavaScript
          source: |
            const response = await fetch(
              "https://api.fantasypros.com/public/v2/json/nfl/players?ecr=included&show=pos_rank",
              { headers: { "x-api-key": "YOUR_API_KEY" } }
            );
            const data = await response.json();
            console.log(data.players);
        - lang: Python
          label: Python
          source: |
            import requests

            resp = requests.get(
                "https://api.fantasypros.com/public/v2/json/nfl/players",
                headers={"x-api-key": "YOUR_API_KEY"},
                params={"ecr": "included", "show": "pos_rank"},
            )
            data = resp.json()
            print(data["players"])
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/Sport'
        - name: player
          description: A FantasyPros player ID to filter results on
          in: query
          required: false
          schema:
            type: integer
            default: null
            example: 6880
        - name: update
          description: >-
            Only return players that have been updated since this date. Format
            YYYY-MM-DD
          in: query
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
            default: null
            example: '2025-05-13'
        - name: ecr
          description: >-
            A flag on whether to include or exclude players that are in
            consensus rankings.
          in: query
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
            enum:
              - included
              - excluded
              - null
            default: null
            example: included
        - name: external_ids
          in: query
          description: >-
            Colon-delimited string of external IDs to include in the player
            object
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
            pattern: ^(\w+)((?:\:\w+)+)?$
            default: null
            enum:
              - yahoo
              - espn
              - cbs
              - rts
              - fanduel
              - draftkings
              - fantasydraft
              - rotogrinders
              - fleaflicker
              - rotowire
              - rotoworld
              - numberfire
              - fantrax
              - nfl
              - mfl
              - tsn
              - onroto
              - xmlteam
              - ffwc
              - mlbam
              - nba
              - null
            example: yahoo:espn:cbs
        - name: show
          in: query
          description: Show the players positional consensus ranking in addition to overall
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
            default: null
            enum:
              - pos_rank
              - null
            example: pos_rank
      responses:
        '200':
          description: A successful response
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                oneOf:
                  - $ref: '#/components/schemas/NFLPlayerResponse'
                  - $ref: '#/components/schemas/MLBPlayerResponse'
                  - $ref: '#/components/schemas/NBAPlayerResponse'
                  - $ref: '#/components/schemas/NHLPlayerResponse'
                discriminator:
                  propertyName: sport
                  mapping:
                    NFL: '#/components/schemas/NFLPlayerResponse'
                    MLB: '#/components/schemas/MLBPlayerResponse'
                    NBA: '#/components/schemas/NBAPlayerResponse'
                    NHL: '#/components/schemas/NHLPlayerResponse'
      security:
        - api_key: []

        - name: MLBAMID

            default: null
        - name: fpid
          description: A FantasyPros player id to filter returned news
          in: query
          required: false
          schema:
            type: integer
            example: 6880
            default: null
        - name: limit
          description: The number of news items to be returned
          in: query
          required: false
          schema:
            type: integer
            maximum: 100
            default: 25
        - name: category
          description: The type of news items to return
          in: query
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
            enum:
              - injury
              - recap
              - transaction
              - rumor
              - breaking
              - null
            default: null
        - name: order_by
          description: The order by direction for the news items
          in: query
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
            enum:
              - updated
              - created
            default: created
      responses:
        '200':
          description: A successful response
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                required:
                  - sport
                  - title
                  - description
                  - count
                  - items
                properties:
                  sport:
                    type: string
                    example: MLB
                  title:
                    type: string
                    example: Fantasy Player News
                  description:
                    type: string
                    example: >-
                      Breaking Fantasy Baseball player news along with the
                      impact for fantasy managers
                  count:
                    type: integer
                    example: 25
                  items:
                    type: array
                    items:
                      type: object
                      required:
                        - id
                        - created
                        - created_formated
                        - author
                        - player_id
                        - team_id
                        - title
                        - sport_id
                        - categories
                        - link
                        - desc
                        - impact

                          type: string

                          example: Mon, May 12th 7:29am UTC
                        author:

                          example: Ari Koslow

                          $ref: '#/components/schemas/PlayerId'

                          $ref: '#/components/schemas/TeamId'

                          example: MLB
                        categories:
                          type: array
                          items:
                            type: string
                          example:
                            - Commentary
                            - News
                        link:
                          type: string
                          format: url
                          example: >-
                            https://www.fantasypros.com/mlb/news/519470/caleb-freeman-optioned-to-triple-a.php
                        desc:
                          type: string
                          example: >-
                            The White Sox optioned RHP Caleb Freeman to Triple-A
                            Charlotte.
                        impact:
                          type: string
                          example: >-
                            Freeman is sent back down one week after he had his
                            contract selected. The White Sox needed to open a
                            roster spot after claiming Yoendys Gómez off waivers
                            from the Dodgers.
      security:
        - api_key: []

Using our Fantasy Advice Search Tool (FAST), Who Should I Draft? provides instant advice for the biggest question you’ll have on draft day. The feature takes the guesswork out of who to take by allowing you to compare multiple fantasy options (up to four at once for [Premium members](https://secure.fantasypros.com/plans/)) and compare every expert’s recommendation side by side.

**[Auction Calculator](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/auction-values/calculator.php)** When snake drafts just won’t cut it, we have just what you need to dominate your auction draft. You can also break things down based on strength of starters/bench, view your best and worst picks by round and see the draft board in its entirety.

[**Perfect Draft Challenge**](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/perfect-draft/)

Invite your friends and compete on our community leaderboards to see how you stack up. Drafts are free and take just 5-10 minutes.

body:
Get the most thorough cross-section of fantasy football projections right here! We offer a consensus of projections provided from multiple sources – and if you’re more interested in a player’s potential range of outcomes, we offer that, as well. Included here is a “ [Projected Leaders](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/projections/leaders.php)” section where you can see where the projection systems rank players in a variety of categories.

[![](https://cdn.fantasypros.com/wp-content/uploads/Screen-Shot-2020-07-09-at-2.28.31-PM-560x326.png)](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/projections/leaders.php)

**[Fantasy Strength of Schedule](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/strength-of-schedule.php)** Which fantasy players have the easiest or most difficult fantasy schedules for the coming season? We have the answers in our team-by-team Strength of Schedule tool, which displays the relative ease or difficulty of each NFL team’s matchups for the season. SOS is based on each opponent’s fantasy points allowed to a position, adjusted for strength of schedule. Favorable matchups receive better matchup star ratings. You can learn more about the methodology [here](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl-matchup-ratings/).

**[Fantasy Depth Charts](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/depth-charts.php)** You need to know each teams’ pecking order come draft day – so let us help you with our easy-to-follow Depth Charts tool, which is updated frequently – and includes each player’s overall Expert Consensus Rankings, so you know which backups are worth watching the most as you get into the latter stages of your fantasy draft.

**[Value-Based Drafting Tool](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/rankings/vbd.php)** Not down with VBD? Well, you should be! We offer a detailed look at each player’s standing using value-based drafting (VBD), a strategy that assigns a value to every player by comparing that player’s fantasy points to the fantasy points of a baseline player at the same position. A high VBD means a player offers strong incremental value at his position and is therefore valuable overall in fantasy. Check out our [Value-Based Drafting Guide](https://www.fantasypros.com/2017/06/what-is-value-based-drafting/) for more VBD insight.

**[Fantasy Matchup Calendar](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/matchups/qb.php)** Get a handle on just what kind of schedule your fantasy players have on the horizon with out Fantasy Matchup Calendar, which assigns each player a grade out of five stars based on the difficulty of their upcoming games. Ratings are based on a combination of opponents’ points against (adjusted for SOS) and the player’s overall skill level.

[QB](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/matchups/qb.php) \| [RB](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/matchups/rb.php) \| [WR](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/matchups/wr.php) \| [TE](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/matchups/te.php) \| [K](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/matchups/k.php) \| [DST](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/matchups/dst.php)

[![](https://cdn.fantasypros.com/wp-content/uploads/Screen-Shot-2020-06-25-at-9.29.27-AM-560x530.png)](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/matchups/qb.php)

[**Running Back Handcuffs**](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/running-back-handcuffs.php)

Whether you believe in securing your elite running back’s handcuff or you’re looking to poach someone else’s, we have the perfect tool for you. Not only do we provide the most valuable handcuffs to own from a fantasy football standpoint (with adjustable scoring format and league size), we also include their current Expert Consensus Ranking – along with where they’re presently being drafted, so you know exactly how early you’ll have to commit to one if you want him.

**[Consensus Sleepers/Busts](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/sleepers.php)** Getting a handle on the industry’s top sleepers and busts is a must come draft time. And we have the simplest way for you to identify which players are worth reaching for, and which ones should be left for someone else to draft. Our Consensus Sleepers and Busts tools compare current Expert Consensus Rankings with updated Average Draft Position; the bigger the difference between the two, the more pronounced a sleeper or bust the player is pegged to be.

[Sleepers](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/sleepers.php) \| [Busts](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/busts.php)

**[Bye Week Cheat Sheet](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/bye-week-cheatsheet.php)** Need help sorting out the bye weeks during your fantasy football season? Our Bye Week Cheat Sheet does the work for you. We list every fantasy-relevant player in order of earliest to latest bye week, along with each player’s Expert Consensus Ranking (so you can get a good sense of how punishing each bye week is from a talent standpoint). You can also set the lists to display only players on your team, players owned in your league and those on the waiver wire.

[**2020 Draft Kit**](https://www.fantasypros.com/fantasy-football-draft-kit/)

Draft kits remain one of the lifebloods of the fantasy football industry – and ours is among the best in the business. We offer printable cheat sheets driven by our industry-leading Expert Consensus Rankings, along with access to a wealth of helpful fantasy football articles. You’ll get the most in-depth look at the 2019 season, and the most reliable look ahead to the 2020 campaign. And best of all, it’s absolutely FREE!

[![](https://cdn.fantasypros.com/wp-content/uploads/Screen-Shot-2020-07-10-at-10.00.33-AM-560x387.png)](https://www.fantasypros.com/fantasy-football-draft-kit/)

**[Fantasy Football 101: Strategy and Tips](https://www.fantasypros.com/fantasy-football-101-strategy-tips-advice/)** Whether you’re a seasoned fantasy sports pro or new to the game, we’re here to help everyone become more profitable fantasy sports players. Before you dive deep into your next draft or DFS lineup, check out our top fantasy football strategy articles to help you win big. We offer tips for every segment of the fantasy calendar, and cover everything from how to plan the perfect fantasy draft party to how to make a truly memorable early-season trade to how to avoid mistakes in your Best Ball drafts.

**[Fantasy Football Articles](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/articles/)** Get your fantasy football strategy fix with our exhaustive library of articles, written by some of the industry’s heaviest hitters. We cover off every fantasy topic imaginable with well-written, well-researched articles that offer something for everyone – and with dozens of articles published each week, you’ll have fresh content to rely on for all of your draft research needs.

**[Breaking Player News](http://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/player-news.php "Breaking Player News")** You need to know every fantasy-relevant news item before you draft your team – and we’re the go-to source. Get the latest news along with a fantasy analysis of the impact on hundreds of players; we provide the option to not only sort between teams and positions, but also the type of news (including breaking news, rumors, injuries and transactions).

\\_\\_\\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

## **In-Season Fantasy Tools**

**[NFL My Playbook](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/myplaybook/)** It’s the ultimate in-season fantasy football resource! Import your fantasy teams to My Playbook and you’ll have access to a wealth of information, stats, trends, expert consensus rankings, in-depth analysis for each of your imported leagues, our industry-leading multi-league assistant tool and so much more.

**[Expert Consensus Rankings](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/rankings/qb.php)** It’s the single most comprehensive compilation of rankings in the industry – and it’s free to use! We gather consensus weekly rankings from well over 100 experts across the three major scoring formats (Standard, 1/2 PPR, PPR) and every offensive and defensive positions. Stick with the majority, or customize your list of experts based on your personal preference. **Standard:** [QB](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/rankings/qb.php) \| [RB](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/rankings/rb.php) \| [WR](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/rankings/qb.php) \| [TE](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/rankings/qb.php) \| [K](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/rankings/k.php) \| [DST](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/rankings/dst.php) \| [IDP](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/rankings/idp.php) **1/2 PPR:** [RB](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/rankings/half-point-ppr-rb.php) \| [WR](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/rankings/half-point-ppr-wr.php) \| [TE](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/rankings/half-point-ppr-te.php) **Full PPR:** [RB](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/rankings/ppr-rb.php) \| [WR](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/rankings/ppr-wr.php) \| [TE](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/rankings/ppr-te.php)

**[Rest-of-Season Rankings](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/rankings/ros-overall.php)** Get a handle on how your fantasy football players are expected to perform over the remainder of the season with our thorough rest-of-season rankings, which provide a solid snapshot of how the industry feels about hundreds of fantasy-relevant options.

**Standard:** [Overall](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/rankings/ros-overall.php) **\|** [QB](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/rankings/ros-qb.php) \| [RB](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/rankings/ros-rb.php) \| [WR](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/rankings/ros-wr.php) \| [TE](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/rankings/ros-te.php) \| [K](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/rankings/ros-k.php) \| [DST](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/rankings/ros-dst.php) \| [IDP](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/rankings/ros-idp.php) **1/2 PPR:** [RB](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/rankings/ros-half-point-ppr-rb.php) \| [WR](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/rankings/half-point-ppr-wr.php) \| [TE](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/rankings/ros-half-point-ppr-te.php) **Full PPR:** [RB](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/rankings/ros-ppr-rb.php) \| [WR](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/rankings/ros-ppr-wr.php) \| [TE](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/rankings/ros-ppr-te.php)

[**Who Should I Start?**](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/start/)

It’s the biggest decision you’ll make each week during the fantasy football season – so why leave it to chance? Get the experts’ take with our “Who Should I Start?” tool, which allows you to compare multiple players across every skill position (plus D/ST and IDP); standard users can compare any two players in any major scoring format, while Premium subscribers can compare up to four players. Use the expert consensus, or narrow the options down to specific fantasy analysts.

[![](https://cdn.fantasypros.com/wp-content/uploads/Screen-Shot-2020-07-15-at-3.33.42-PM-560x324.png)](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/start/)

**[Start/Sit Assistant](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/myplaybook/football-start-sit-assistant.php)** Setting your weekly fantasy lineups has never been so easy! Our Start/Sit Assistant provides an instant recommendation on the best lineup for this week, along with the percentage of fantasy experts who would start each player on your roster. **[Auto-Pilot](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/myplaybook/auto-pilot.php)** Saddled with too many fantasy leagues and not enough time to manage them all? Let us do the work for you! Auto-Pilot gives you the option of having your lineup changes submitted automatically each week. body:
**[Waiver Wire Assistant](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/myplaybook/waiver-wire-assistant.php)** Take the worry out of your weekly waiver wire experience with our Waiver Wire Assistant! Once your league is synced, we pull the available players from your league. We then present you the best available players in your league based on expert rankings for the next week as well as rest of season (ROS). This helps you quickly identify players that may be beneficial to your team, as well as allow you to compare how much your team may improve (or worsen) based on potential drops from your active roster.

**[Trade Analyzer](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/myplaybook/trade-analyzer.php)** Are you getting a steal in that fantasy trade you proposed? Or are you getting fleeced? Find out quickly and accurately with our Trade Analyzer feature! We offer instant analysis on trade offers across a wide variety of scoring and roster settings – and you can propose uneven trades, as well! We’ll show you our version of your league Power Rankings before and after the proposed trade so you can see exactly how you’re expected to fare based on our rest-of-season rankings and projections.

**[Trade Finder](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/myplaybook/football-trade-finder.php)** It’s the most comprehensive trade finder tool in the industry – and it’s yours to use! Our Trade Finder allows fantasy players to find the ideal trade targets based on a variety of factors, including strength of schedule, lineup need and optimal return value. Trade Finder will look for bench options on other teams that would be worthy of starting on your squad. You can even seek out “win-win” trade scenarios if you’re looking to sweeten your proposals.

[![](https://cdn.fantasypros.com/wp-content/uploads/nfl-mpb-trade-finder-screenshot-560x309.png)](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/myplaybook/football-trade-finder.php)

And how far off the pace are you (if you aren’t the front-runner)? Get the answers you’re looking for with our League Analyzer, which provides detailed power rankings for your league, based on accurate consensus projections. See how your team stacks up in each scoring category, so you’ll know where you need to improve. You can also find out how the experts rate your roster compared to your opponents’.

**[Research Assistant](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/myplaybook/research-assistant.php)** Take your fantasy football research one step further without Research Assistant browser bookmarklet! This tool allows you to access fantasy-relevant information on any website featuring NFL players; not only will you be able to see if the player you’re reading about is available in your fantasy leagues, you’ll also have instant access to his FantasyPros player card! Best of all, Research Assistant is available on Chrome, Firefox and Safari browsers!

[**Multi-League Assistant**](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/myleagues/)

Why spend countless hours bouncing from one fantasy team to the next when you can manage all of them in one convenient place? Our Multi-League Assistant lets you do just that, highlighted by our dashboard where you can see every player on every team you own! Our Free Agent Finder will identify the best roster additions across all of your leagues, along with their availability by league; from there, you can add players to your roster in an instant.

[![](https://cdn.fantasypros.com/wp-content/uploads/nfl-mpb-multi-league-assistant-screenshot-560x348.png)](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/myleagues/)

**[Game Day Live Updates](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/gameday.php)** No other update tool gives you a more detailed look at your weekly fantasy fortunes! Our Game Day Live Update feature tracks scoring for all of your fantasy leagues in real-time, no matter the scoring format! You can track each of your weekly matchups in one convenient place, while perusing instantly updated statistical leaderboards across all positions. And you don’t have to wait until the weekend – our Game Day Live runs Thursday nights, as well!

\\_\\_\\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

body:
**[Breaking Player News](http://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/player-news.php "Breaking Player News")** You need to know every fantasy-relevant news item before you finalize your lineup – and we’re the go-to source. Get the latest news along with a fantasy analysis of the impact on hundreds of players; we provide the option to not only sort between teams and positions, but also the type of news (including breaking news, rumors, injuries and transactions).

**[Prospect Rankings](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/rankings/prospects-overall.php)** Why wait until next season to learn about the players who will stock your next dynasty rookie draft? We have prospect rankings before the majority of the industry, and keep them updated after each week of the college football season. We also rank non-skill players for those of you in dynasty IDP formats. So get your prospect fix with us!

[Overall](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/rankings/prospects-overall.php) \| [QB](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/rankings/prospects-qb.php) \| [RB](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/rankings/prospects-rb.php) \| [WR](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/rankings/prospects-wr.php) \| [TE](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/rankings/prospects-te.php)

\\_\\_\\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

## **Daily Fantasy Sports**

**[DFS Lineup Optimizer](https://www.fantasypros.com/daily-fantasy/nfl/lineup-optimizer.php)** Save yourself some time, and win yourself some money! Our DFS Lineup Optimizer uses the latest weekly projections to identify which combination of players would produce the greatest production in fantasy points at the lowest cost.  This eliminates hours of research each night looking up stats, news, player situations, and trends by using this data to create an optimal lineup.  The projections we use in the Optimizer are constantly being updated; we then use those player projections to create the best possible lineup using the salary available.

**[DFS Saved Lineups History](https://www.fantasypros.com/daily-fantasy/nfl/fanduel-saved-lineups-history.php)** Tracking is everything in daily fantasy, and we offer a tool that will help you do so effectively! Revisit your previous DFS rosters in your Saved Lineups History, which tracks prior submissions across a variety of daily fantasy sites including FanDuel and DraftKings. See what worked in the past – and just as importantly, what didn’t.

**[DFS Cheat Sheets](https://www.fantasypros.com/daily-fantasy/nfl/fanduel-cheatsheet.php)** Our NFL daily fantasy cheat sheets are a revelation for those of you looking to get as much DFS-relevant information in one place. Not only do we offer detailed cheat sheets for a variety of DFS providers, each sheet is packed full of relevant stats and information, including (but certainly not limited to) game spread, projected scoring output, overall difference between projection rank and salary rank and projected ownership. You can also automatically hide injured players!

[![](https://cdn.fantasypros.com/wp-content/uploads/FDCheatSHeet-560x290.png)](https://www.fantasypros.com/daily-fantasy/nfl/fanduel-cheatsheet.php)

**[Projected DFS Ownership](https://www.fantasypros.com/daily-fantasy/nfl/fanduel-player-ownership.php)** If you don’t know why it’s important to take projected ownership into consideration ahead of your daily fantasy roster decisions, you have some work to do. So take our word for it: ownership rates are critical – and we have one of the most reliable projection models in the industry right at your fingertips! Check out our list of projected ownership projections across all positions before settling on your final DFS lineups.

**[DFS Value Plays](https://www.fantasypros.com/daily-fantasy/nfl/fanduel-undervalued-players.php)** As with the majority of daily fantasy tools at your disposal, our DFS Value Plays feature looks to take the legwork out of building consistently strong NFL lineups across both cash games and GPPs. We break down the most undervalued plays by position (yes, even D/STs!) entering the upcoming NFL week, with a separate tab for the most overvalued options. And you can customize the list of experts you’re referencing to ensure you’re getting the most satisfactory sources.

**[DFS Salary Changes](https://www.fantasypros.com/daily-fantasy/nfl/fanduel-salary-changes.php)** Daily fantasy salaries fluctuate from week to week – and it’s important to know how a player’s salary is trending to help determine whether there’s potential value at his current cost. Our DFS Salary Changes tool tracks salary movement throughout the season, highlighting the biggest risers and fallers heading into a given NFL week.

[**DFS Performance History**](https://www.fantasypros.com/daily-fantasy/nfl/performance-history.php)

It might be one of our most undervalued tools – and it’s free to use! Check out our DFS Performance History feature, which allows you to upload all of your prior results from FanDuel and/or DraftKings. We then compile everything into easily consumable bundles of stats like average score, win rate, net profit and ROI! You can get even more granular if you like, as we allow you to sort your results by contest type, contest size and entry fee; you can also filter by sport and date range, among other options.

[![](https://cdn.fantasypros.com/wp-content/uploads/Screen-Shot-2020-07-16-at-8.49.34-AM-560x299.png)](https://www.fantasypros.com/daily-fantasy/nfl/performance-history.php)

[**DFS Articles**](https://www.fantasypros.com/content/dfs/)

Get your daily fantasy football fix with our comprehensive library of articles. We offer a wide range of well-written, well-researched articles for both cash game and tournament players that offer something for everyone – and with several articles published each week, you’ll have fresh content to rely on for all of your in-season DFS needs.

\\_\\_\\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

### **Expert-Specific Tools**

**[Expert Consensus Rankings](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/rankings/qb.php)** It’s the single most comprehensive compilation of rankings in the industry – and it’s free to use! We gather consensus weekly rankings from well over 100 experts across the three major scoring formats (Standard, 1/2 PPR, PPR) and every offensive and defensive positions. Stick with the majority, or customize your list of experts based on your personal preference. **Standard:** [QB](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/rankings/qb.php) \| [RB](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/rankings/rb.php) \| [WR](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/rankings/qb.php) \| [TE](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/rankings/qb.php) \| [K](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/rankings/k.php) \| [DST](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/rankings/dst.php) \| [IDP](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/rankings/idp.php) **1/2 PPR:** [RB](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/rankings/half-point-ppr-rb.php) \| [WR](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/rankings/half-point-ppr-wr.php) \| [TE](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/rankings/half-point-ppr-te.php) **Full PPR:** [RB](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/rankings/ppr-rb.php) \| [WR](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/rankings/ppr-wr.php) \| [TE](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/rankings/ppr-te.php)

**[Expert Accuracy](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/accuracy/draft.php)** It’s one of the most notable competitions among the industry elite – and it has significant bearing on your future fantasy football decisions. We track Expert Accuracy across both draft and in-season player rankings, while branching off by position so you’ll know which experts have excelled most at rating quarterbacks, running backs, wide receivers or tight ends. We also provide multi-year accuracy rankings – because when it comes to relying on industry leaders, consistency matters a lot.

[Season-to-Date](http://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/accuracy/ "Year-to-Date") \| [Weekly](http://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/accuracy/weekly.php "Weekly") \| [Draft](http://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/accuracy/draft.php "Draft")

**[Dissenting Opinions](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/rankings/compare-experts.php)** What does our Dissenting Opinions tool provide? Imagine pitting two of your favorite fantasy football experts against one another in a fight to the death. Now, remove the “fight to the death” part (we’re not savages, after all.) And there you have it! You can compare any of our contributors to the Expert Consensus Ranking against another expert, or against the main ECR list, and see how their rankings compare; you can also limit the results to gaps of between two and 30 spots in the rankings, so you can see where the experts differ most.

**[Expert Directory](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/rankings/)** It’s the ideal spot for all of your FantasyPros expert needs! In addition to offering easy access to our updated Expert Consensus Rankings (highlighted by the top five across the three main scoring setups and available for either draft or in-season rankings), we also include a list of the top 100 experts that have submitted rankings! We also list when those rankings were updated, and offer direct links to the experts’ rankings and how they compare to ECR, ADP and other individual experts. Bookmark this page right now!
